identity.name: Cord Care That Won't Land You in A&E
identity.subtitle: One evidence-based routine for the umbilical stump - plus the exact words to protect it from harmful 'remedies' without family war
identity.one_line_promise: A clear daily cord-care routine and red-flag triage your whole household follows, so the stump heals safely and you know exactly when to see a doctor.
identity.journey_position: m01 newborn first weeks -> feeds forward into C-Section First-14-Days (surgical recovery) and Omugwo on Your Terms (family boundaries)

customer.target_person: Mother or primary caregiver of a newborn (0-3 weeks), in Nigeria/Africa or the diaspora, receiving conflicting cord advice from elders and staff
customer.situation: The stump is attached; relatives push traditional substances while hospital instructions were vague; she fears infection and blame in both directions
customer.trigger: Hospital discharge + arrival of family helpers with strong opinions
customer.emotional_stake: Believes a preventable infection could kill her baby and that she would be blamed

before_state.summary: Multiple substances applied under pressure; no agreed rule; anxiety at every nappy change

after_state.summary: One clean-dry-exposed routine, posted house rule, five memorized red flags, calm triage instead of panic

mechanism.core: Default-action design + observable triage criteria + respect scripts

first_win.action: House Rule card posted + announcement script sent

failure_map.see: TR failure_point_map: relative-applies-substance / looks-wrong-but-well / red flag / day-21 / new helper

reentry.protocol: Restart Stage 3 with current caregiver; no guilt reset

tsm.note: Canonical TSM lives in TR-PPL-CORD-CARE-001 and WP swiipt_tsm_definitions. Threshold: 60%+ completers meet >=3 of 4 indicators at Day 30. Check-ins Day 0/7/14/30.

content.completion: Day-30 completion check inside tracker: 3-4 of 4 indicators met

currency_rules.note: PLACEHOLDER pricing - owner to set real prices later (owner directive)

responsive_requirements: mobile-first: checklist and rescue card usable one-handed
accessibility_requirements: no color-only meaning on triage tables

sources: Shwe et al. Niger J Clin Pract 2021 PMID 34018987 (Jos RCT)
Onubogu et al. Asian J Pediatr Res 2022 (Nnewi practice survey)
evidence.review_status: Sourced evidence compiled 2026-08-24 from WHO/AAP/peer-reviewed literature; Gate O clinical sign-off by owner/reviewer still pending before launch marketing

safety.disclaimer: Educational content - not medical, clinical, or mental-health advice. Never diagnoses or treats. Any suspected infection goes to professional care the same day.
escalation_rules: Any single red flag = same-day medical care; fever/lethargy = emergency now
Regional emergency lines from verified shared crisis list (Nigeria 112, UK 999, US/Canada 911)
Never wait-and-see with newborn red flags

ai_tests.reason: Self-review only - builder cannot self-approve. Independent AI-QA round + owner clinical confirmation required before launch marketing.
Content matches approved situation (daily cord decisions under family pressure); no neighboring problem absorbed.
All clinical claims carry sourced_evidence labels with citations.
